LESSON: SELF- IMPROVEMENT

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Social Studies and Personal Management Self-Improvement 4 Self- Esteem Assessmen
Topic 1.1: Self- Improvement

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Self- Improvement
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Which animal best reflects your personal characteristics?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe personality traits for self- understanding
2. share goals for self- improvement in social life
3. appreciate the role of values in the development of personality traits

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe personality traits for self- understanding

Teach
• Today’s focus: describe personality traits for self- understanding.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “describe personality traits for self- understanding” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "describe personality traits for self- understanding" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: share goals for self- improvement in social life

• Listen/read the idea.

• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “share goals for self- improvement in social life” using a home/county example.

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 3: appreciate the role of values in the development of personality traits

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe personality traits for self- understanding
• Model 2: share goals for self- improvement in social life
• Model 3: appreciate the role of values in the development of personality traits

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe personality traits for self- understanding
2. Practise: share goals for self- improvement in social life
3. Practise: appreciate the role of values in the development of personality traits

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Self- Improvement.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Which animal best reflects your personal characteristics?
2. What career choices in Social Studies relate to you?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe personality traits for self- understanding
• share goals for self- improvement in social life
• appreciate the role of values in the development of personality traits

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
